sections.description:
Get more leads, sales, and signups with high-converting custom popup plugins by POWR

POWR Popup is your all-in-one solution for boosting sales, promoting discounts and coupons, and growing your email list. Custom discount and newsletter signup pop up are perfect for capturing leads and building strong customer relationships.

Prevent missed opportunities with features like cart abandonment and urgency pop ups, enhancing trust and excitement around your brand. Seamlessly integrates with leading email platforms like Mailchimp, Klaviyo, and Zapier to automate your entire workflow.

15+ million POWR plugin users worldwide can’t be wrong!

🐣 Getting Started

Download, install and activate POWR Popup. Create and save your plugin in the POWR Editor within WordPress. Add POWR Popup to your site.

✨ Popup Plugin Feature Highlights

  • Customizable Templates: Select from a variety of pre-designed templates that can be tailored to match your brand’s style, allowing for quick and easy popup creation.
  • Lead Generation and Email Collection: Collect valuable customer emails through customizable popups to grow your email list for future marketing campaigns.
  • Integration with Marketing Tools: Easy integration with popular email marketing tools like Mailchimp and Klaviyo enables automated workflows and efficient management of collected leads.
  • Responsive Design: Popups are optimized for various devices, ensuring a consistent and user-friendly experience across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
  • Behavioral Triggers and Scheduling: Display popups based on user behavior, such as exit intent or time spent on a page, and schedule them to appear at the right time, with the right message, to maximize engagement.

Upgrade to remove POWR branding and unlock Premium features, such as:

  • Custom triggers: show POWR Popup with time delay, button click, or when user is about to exit your page.
  • Control the frequency with which the POWR Popup should appear to the same visitor.
  • Hide Close button to force user into choosing custom action in popup.
  • Premium features in all POWR apps

Why users love POWR Popup:

“Don’t even consider anything else. Not only is the product outstanding, heads & shoulders above anything else but the support is SUPERB. Use > this app. I reiterate, don’t even THINK about anything else. This is the best POWR Popup with outstanding support!” – paralegalsperdiemh

🚀 6 Ways Popup Plugins Help WordPress Websites Grow

  1. Increase Lead Generation – Popups capture visitor emails through newsletter signups, lead magnets, and exclusive offers to grow your email list.
  2. Reduce Cart Abandonment – Exit-intent popups remind users of abandoned carts and offer discounts to encourage checkout.
  3. Promote Special Offers – Time-sensitive popups create urgency with flash sales, countdown timers, and exclusive discounts.
  4. Enhance User Engagement – Interactive popups like spin-to-win, quizzes, and gamified rewards keep visitors engaged.
  5. Collect Customer Feedback – Survey popups gather insights on customer preferences, helping improve website experience and conversions.
  6. Grow Social Media & Referrals – Popups encourage users to follow, share, or refer friends in exchange for rewards or discounts.

🥇 Popular Popups on WordPress Websites

Newsletter Signup Popup: Offer visitors a chance to subscribe to a newsletter in exchange for exclusive content or updates.
Exit-Intent Popup: Appears when a user is about to leave the site, offering a discount or a lead magnet.
Social Media Follow Popup: Encourage visitors to follow the brand on social platforms for updates.
Early Bird Signup Popup: Invite users to join a waiting list for a new product or feature.
Discount Popup: Offer a percentage off or a special deal for first-time or returning visitors.
Limited-Time Offer Popup: Create urgency by displaying a countdown timer for a sale or promo.
Bundle Deal Popup: Suggest a discounted product bundle or an upsell based on cart contents.
Abandoned Cart Popup: Remind users of items left in their cart and encourages them to complete the purchase.
Free Shipping Popup: Promote free shipping when a user reaches a particular cart value.
Customer Feedback Popup: Ask visitors for their opinions on the website, product, or service.
Referral Program Popup: Invite users to refer friends in exchange for rewards or discounts.
Cookie Consent Popup: Notify users about cookie usage and compliance with GDPR/CCPA laws.
Restock Alert Popup: Allow users to sign up for notifications when an out-of-stock item is available.
Event Registration Popup: Promote an upcoming webinar, live demo, or virtual event.

✅ Not just great social feed plugins — Over 60 No-Code WordPress Plugins Available

With a complete library at your fingertips, here are our WordPress users’ favorites:

Popup: Increase conversions with a pop-up sign-up form, or create a special promotion popup with a coupon code and keep visitors on your site with an exit intent popup. Integrates with Mailchimp and Zapier to make managing contacts a breeze.

Social Feed: Boost engagement on your site and increase brand awareness with a live gallery of photos and videos from all your social media accounts. Create your feed by connecting to Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, Pinterest, Vimeo, YouTube, an RSS feed, and more!

Form Builder: Allows you to create fully customizable forms without coding. It features advanced elements like conditional logic, multi-page forms, and file uploads. The tool also supports payment collection, integrations, and automated responses, making it ideal for lead generation, customer feedback, and e-commerce transactions.

Photo + Video Gallery: Easily create and customize image and video galleries for your website, enhancing visual appeal and engagement. Features include responsive design, hover effects, and social sharing to showcase products, portfolios, or events.

Image Slider: Increase visitor trust with a slideshow of photos, videos, or customer testimonials. Add images, videos, events, and promotional banners with call-to-action buttons to create a beautiful slideshow for your WordPress site. Choose from different transition styles and automatically repeat slides to keep visitors engaged and active.

PayPal Button: Collect payments quickly and securely on your WordPress site. Accept one-time payments, set up subscriptions, or collect donations. Customize the button text, receive email notifications when a payment is made, and design your autoresponder email to ensure successful payments.

You can also get unlimited access to 60+ plugins like contact form, popup, countdown timer, image slider, and more for one deeply discounted price. Over $900/yr in savings!

sections.installation:
Download, Install and Activate POWR Popup.

A POWR account will automatically be created for you and you will see the POWR Editor in WordPress, where you can build and customize your POWR Popup.

Once you`ve saved your plugin you will see install instructions. You can continue editing the plugin on your live page, in your WP Dashboard, or by logging in to www.powr.io.

To add your plugin to a Page or Post, follow these steps:

1. Copy your shortcode.
2. Go to your WordPress Dashboard and click on Pages and All Pages.
3. Hover over the page to add the plugin to and click Edit.
4. Paste your shortcode snippet in text box.
5. Click Update and Preview Changes.

To add your plugin to a Theme, follow these steps:

1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard and select Appearance and Widgets from the dropdown menu.
2. Drag and drop your plugin into any sidebar or footer, then Save.
3. Visit your live site by clicking the home button in the upper left-hand side and click Visit Site.
4. Find the plugin and click on the Edit button. This will open the POWR Editor.
5. To import a POWR Popup you have already saved, click Import Existing POWR Popup, find your Plugin and click Copy. Your POWR Popup is now on your WordPress site.
sections.faq:
What is POWR?

POWR is a service that makes Plugins designed to increase engagement and conversions on your WordPress site!

Do I need to create a POWR Account?

Yes, you need a POWR Account. Creating a POWR Account allows you to create and save plugins, edit them in your live page, and use them on multiple different websites.

How do I add POWR Popup to a page or blog post?

Create and save the plugin in your WP Dashboard.

1. Copy your shortcode.
2. Go to your WordPress Dashboard and click on Pages and All Pages.
3. Hover over the page to add the plugin to and click Edit.
4. Paste your shortcode snippet in text box.
5. Click Update and Preview Changes.

You can continue editing the plugin on your live page, in your WP Dashboard, or by logging in to powr.io.

How do I add POWR Popup to a theme?

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard and select Appearance and Widgets from the dropdown menu.
  2. Drag and drop your plugin into any sidebar or footer, then Save.
  3. Visit your live site by clicking the home button in the upper left-hand side and click Visit Site.
  4. Find the plugin and click on the Edit button. This will open the POWR Editor.
  5. To import a POWR Popup you have already saved, click Import Existing POWR Popup, find your Plugin and click Copy. Your POWR Popup is now on your WordPress site.

Can I add more than one POWR Popup?

Yes, absolutely! To clone an existing POWR Popup, paste the exact same unique shortcode into another page or post. To create a new version, select POWR Popup from the sidebar in your WP Dashboard and click Create New. You can then edit and save a new version, and paste the new unique shortcode into a page or post.

Will my users see the Edit button above POWR Popup?

No! You only see the Edit button because you own the plugin. To temporarily hide it, click on your page and then type ‘p + down arrow’ (the letter p followed by the down arrow). You can show the icon again by typing ‘p + up-arrow’.

I can’t see the settings icon anymore, what happened?

You are just logged out of POWR.io. Visit www.powr.io and log in to your account. Then return to your website and refresh the page.

Is POWR Popup Free?

Yes, the basic version of POWR Popup is completely free!

Why should I upgrade?

Upgrading gives you access to advanced features, removes the POWR logo, and gives you automatic priority support.
